mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( ID, PASS, NAME, PHONE, EMAIL, GENDER, ZIPCODE, ADDRESS1, ADDRESS2, REG_DATE, MONEY ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{pass}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{gender}, #{zipcode}, #{address1}, #{address2}, sysdate, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET PASS = #{pass}, NAME = #{name}, PHONE = #{phone}, EMAIL = #{email}, GENDER = #{gender}, ZIPCODE = #{zipcode}, ADDRESS1 = #{address1}, ADDRESS2 = #{address2}, MONEY = #{money} WHERE ID = #{id}
